title: ROCmFPX transferable-mechanism campaign on Qwen3.6-35B-A3B gfx1151
scope: Aggregate decision index. Numeric claims retain the status and qualifications of their linked per-opportunity artifacts; this aggregate does not create a new model topline.

hardware.system: HP ZBook Ultra G1a / AMD Ryzen AI MAX+ PRO 395

baseline.mtp_reason: The packed-PARO snapshot used for arithmetic opportunities contains no NextN sidecar; adaptive MTP used the admitted MTP-bearing Q4_K_M artifact.

opportunities.name: true small-M weight reuse
opportunities.result: c4 +3.41% aggregate tok/s and -2.50% median step; c8 +4.00% and -3.96%; all generated IDs exact versus independent c1

opportunities.name: one-plane Q8_1 production arithmetic
opportunities.path: Q8_1 quantize + sudot4 at exact 35B MoE geometry
opportunities.result: projection speed screens reach 1.02x..1.83x, but operation-complete SiLU max KL reaches 0.693..54.209 and violates the KL<=0.05 gate

opportunities.name: compound arithmetic boundary fusion
opportunities.path: packed PARO shared-prefill FP16 SiLU + down-rotation
opportunities.result: actual 512x512/group128/krot8 leaf 29.643 -> 21.617 us (1.371x); c8/L4 trace 4644 -> 4575 dispatches (-69); primitive output and c4/c8 generated IDs exact; bracketed complete wall neutral
opportunities.strict_fallback: registered separate SiLU then rotation primitives; HIPENGINE_SHARED_PREFILL_SILU_ROTATE_FUSED=0 rollback

opportunities.name: selective unsafe-math compilation
opportunities.path: separate hashed PARO SiLU/rotate code object
opportunities.result: finite top-1 100%, mean KL 4.74e-13, and NaN/Inf classes match, but actual leaf regresses 20.032 -> 21.569 us (-7.67%)

opportunities.name: adaptive MTP admission/depth
opportunities.path: Q4_K_M+NextN prompt-agnostic p_min=0.5 B1 probe with full-accept promotion
opportunities.result: adaptive B3 27.054 tok/s / 37.140 ms-output, 1.134x same-run strict-profile AR, 1.116x best fixed depth, and 1.223x fixed B3; adaptive and fixed controls each exact 30/30
opportunities.qualification: No new cap/topline: B3 is only +0.97% over adaptive B2 in one dirty-provenance packet under a changed execution-profile denominator.

retained_state.small_m: Existing exact output-column-tiled pack8 route remains default.
retained_state.q8_oneplane: No production route retained; strict BF16/FP16 activations remain.
retained_state.silu_rotate: Exact pair-rotate fusion is default-on with strict registered fallback and temporary rollback env.
retained_state.unsafe_math: No unsafe code object or build/runtime flag remains.
retained_state.adaptive_mtp: Existing prompt-agnostic adaptive structure remains; no prompt map and no new cap promotion.

next_actions: Keep exact small-M weight reuse and exact SiLU/rotate fusion.
Revisit activation quantization only with residual/two-plane Q8_1x2 and an operation-complete oracle.
Do not revisit unsafe math for this family without a different operation-level hypothesis.
Require a clean repeated adaptive B2/B3 bracket under one resolved execution profile before any MTP cap/topline change.
